# Questioning data visualisations

## Image 1

```{r echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("img/Speaking-the-world.jpg")
```


Bar graph is hard to interpret as its not representative of the amount it carries.Different colors can be misleading.



## Image 2

```{r echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("img/rose-pop-density-total-area-bw.jpg")
```


Pie chart is hard to interpret as no numbers is present. Pie chart is disorderly and the color makes it confusing.



## Image 3

```{r echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("img/life-expectancy-rule-of-law.png")
```
the overlapping of each point on the scatter graph makes it hard to read. The different sizes of the point also makes it confusing. 



## Image 4

The graph can be understood but theres excessive words that initially makes it confusing.
